Messages.Body:
I understand that if an IC member is given a title, he loses his '4 votes',
but is "IC member" a title (I'm gusessing not, since IC members aren't
allowed to use P/J cards, apparently for this same reason).

That is, could and IC member become a Prince and still be an IC member (with
a sum total of 2 votes)?
